specifications.title: Stall cMIP: the seller may change the offer, or leave its service alone (task K4, condition), draft 1. Terms that name this cMIP in condition name one seller and one service among their signers, as their words say. A new version is valid, and replaces the one it names, (a) when it carries the assent of every party named as a signer, and of no buyer; or (b) when it carries the seller's assent alone, and its only changes are to take the service out: the service's party and line removed, the receiver made the seller, the control socket emptied. Under (a) and (b) alike, nothing a buyer has already earned is changed (G10.6): a new version changes the price, the words or the receiver only for buyers who have not yet paid, and a version that would take from an earned filling is not valid. No parameters. Its fingerprint, as Stall names it in Terms: the id of the act that publishes this text. Free to use, copy and replace. Stall (ddafffcd…a66e).
